Widget? _restageA2uiBuildChild(ChildWidgetBuilder buildChild, Object? child) {
  return child is ComponentNode<ComponentImplementation>
      ? buildChild(child)
      : null;
}

Widget _restageA2uiRequireChild(
    ChildWidgetBuilder buildChild, Object? child, String propertyContext) {
  if (child is! ComponentNode<ComponentImplementation> || child.isPlaceholder) {
    throw StateError(
        'Required A2UI child "$propertyContext" could not resolve. Provide a non-empty String id for a component registered on this surface.');
  }
  return buildChild(child);
}

List<Widget> _restageA2uiBuildChildren(
        ChildWidgetBuilder buildChild, Object? children) =>
    [
      if (children is List)
        for (final child in children)
          if (child is ComponentNode<ComponentImplementation>)
            buildChild(child),
    ];

Color? _restageA2uiColor(String? value) {
  if (value == null || value.isEmpty) return null;
  final normalized = value.startsWith('#')
      ? value.substring(1)
      : value.startsWith(
          '0x',
        )
          ? value.substring(2)
          : value;
  final parsed = int.tryParse(normalized, radix: 16);
  if (parsed == null) return null;
  if (normalized.length <= 6) return Color(0xFF000000 | parsed);
  return Color(parsed);
}

FontWeight _restageA2uiFontWeight(
  num? value,
  FontWeight fallback,
) {
  if (value == null) return fallback;
  final index = value.toInt();
  if (index < 0 || index >= FontWeight.values.length) {
    return fallback;
  }
  return FontWeight.values[index];
}
